# Test Zone

> AI-powered testing platform that streamlines automation workflows using Hive Mind intelligence, smart script generation, and bug tracking.

Test Zone helps QA engineers and developers create Jira tickets, generate test cases, build logic scenarios, generate XPath selectors, and run automated workflows — powered by an integrated AI assistant.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Hive Mind workspace, automation tools, history, mentions, and tickets.
- [Current Chat](/chat): AI-powered Jira ticket creation chat.
- [QA Mock Test](/qa-mock-test): Daily QA skill challenge with multiple-choice questions.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/auth/login): Account sign-in.
- [Sign Up](/auth/signup): Create a Test Zone account.
- [Forgot Password](/auth/forgot-password): Reset your password.
